messages:
sara-chen: quick heads-up — customer reported CSV export from Console audit viewer is missing KMS key info and shows inconsistent masking for user_email. repro attached below. :eyes:

mike-ortiz: can repro locally. looks like serializer expects `kms_key_id` but the new events use `kms.id` after the schema bump. when CSV generator sees unknown field it writes empty cell.

ajay: two separate issues here: RBAC masking is intentional for `audit_viewer` role (we hide full_email), but the JSON export was returning the unmasked field while CSV shows masked value (front-end post-processing). mismatch between export code paths.

liz: also saw that exports only include the current UI page sometimes — if you have 2k events you get only first 100 exported. I think UI triggers export using pagination token incorrectly. it's server-side paging; export should request `all=true` or use streaming endpoint.

beth: customer complained they needed the `kms_key_id` to validate key rotation and for their audit retention. blank column broke their ingestion.

sara-chen: minimal repro (paste):
```csv
timestamp,actor,action,kms_key_id,user_email
2026-03-02T18:22:10Z,service-account-42,encrypt,,***@example.com
2026-03-02T18:24:01Z,alice,create,k-abc123,***@example.com
```

and the raw event in event-store shows: 
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-02T18:22:10Z","actor":"service-account-42","action":"encrypt","kms":{"id":"k-xyz987"},"user_email":"alice@example.com"}
```

mike-ortiz: yep, serializer mapping lost `kms.id` -> `kms_key_id`. patch idea: serializer should read both `kms.id` and fallback to `kms_key_id` for older records. I can add that and a migration test. will also log the trace id so we can find impacted workspaces. trace: `trace-9f2a`

ajay: for RBAC, we need to make explicit whether exports are allowed to contain raw PII for roles. current policy: `audit_viewer` gets masked emails, `security_admin` gets raw. exporter was accidentally bypassing mask for JSON exports for enterprise tenants with KMS-unwrap permissions. need policy check.

liz: for pagination, quick fix is to change export button to call the server streaming-export endpoint (will request all pages). longer-term: server should accept `export_all=true` and internally paginate/stream. I can spike this tomorrow.

beth: tagging @sec-oncall to triage for severity and customer comms.

sec-oncall: oncall here. labeled as P2 until we confirm scope. sec-bot, please create issue and link workspace id.

sec-bot: created issue SEC-277: "Audit export: schema mismatch, pagination, and RBAC masking inconsistency" — https://redwood.internal/SEC-277 (assigned to mike-ortiz).

mike-ortiz: I'm opening PR with serializer fallback + tests. will add feature flag to enable legacy fallback for 2 weeks. ETA: EOD today.

ajay: I will update the RBAC docs and perms matrix (internal) and add explicit checks in exporter to enforce masking rules based on role and tenant flags.

liz: I'll add an e2e test that populates 1200 events and verifies CSV/JSON exports contain identical rows (modulo masking per-role). will also change UI to call streaming endpoint as short-term mitigation.

sara-chen: action items summarized: 1) serializer fallback for kms id (mike), 2) enforce RBAC masking at exporter boundary (ajay), 3) fix export-all/pagination (liz), 4) add e2e parity tests + unit tests (liz/mike), 5) update customer comms and ask for workspace id (sara). I'll DM the reporter for workspace id.

deploy-bot: PR #5234 merged to staging, start rollout to staging cluster at 2026-03-02T22:01:00Z.

beth: thanks team; please update SEC-277 with any customer-facing notes and ETA.

sara-chen: will do. keeping this thread for follow-ups. :lock:
